## Subjective

35yo M, no significant PMH, presents with 4 days of clear nasal discharge, mild sore throat, occasional dry cough. Denies fever, productive sputum, dyspnea, body aches beyond mild fatigue. No sick contacts beyond child in daycare. NKDA.

## Objective

VS: BP 122/78, HR 80, T 98.7°F. Gen: NAD, comfortable. HEENT: clear oropharynx, no exudate, no erythema; TMs clear. Lungs: CTAB.

## Assessment

1. Acute viral URI (J06.9)

## Plan

Supportive care only: hydration, rest, OTC saline rinses, OTC NSAID PRN. No abx indicated. Return if fever develops, symptoms persist >10 days, or shortness of breath. Patient educated on symptom duration expectations.
